summary: OpenAI announced it will wind down its contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor following Cursor's acquisition by SpaceX.

mechanisms.reason: Ending the contract that supplied OpenAI models to Cursor removes a source of inference volume from a widely used coding tool.
mechanisms.quote: Our decision to wind down our contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX.

practices.reason: Teams relying on OpenAI models through Cursor will need to migrate to alternative models or providers as the contract winds down.

notable_reason: A major coding-agent product losing access to OpenAI models signals a notable shift in the AI developer tooling ecosystem tied to a corporate acquisition.
